# Wavelink Global Trust Infrastructure

> Enterprise-grade NFC-powered smart cards and verifiable reputation systems for global growth.

Wavelink is the digital layer for physical business interactions. We provide the infrastructure needed to bridge the gap between in-person meetings and high-trust digital profiles. Optimized for emerging markets seeking global-grade professional standards.

## The 3-Second Attention System
Our interface is engineered for the 3-second attention span. Every interaction—from an NFC tap to a web profile load—is designed for instant conversion and verifiable trust.

## Core Infrastructure
- **Global Trust Cards**: Industrial-grade NFC cards that deploy business identities instantly.
- **Reputation Acceleration Towers**: Physical review stands that compound social proof via Google and Trustpilot at the point of interaction.
- **Digital Infrastructure**: Real-time verifiable profiles with deep integration for professional networking.
